thread:
zoe: starting a thread to track the auditor's RBAC + KMS evidence request. scope = 12 months unless auditor asks otherwise.

kai: can you confirm exact control IDs they want mapped? we have different labels for SOC2 vs ISO.

auditor_bot: Please map controls for Access Control, Key Management, and Audit Logging. Deliverables: role-principal mapping CSV, CloudTrail exports for KMS (GenerateDataKey, Decrypt, ReEncrypt, CreateGrant), and a signed attestation. CSV/manifest + hashed bundle preferred.

ana: plan: 1) IAM role change history (csv) 2) k8s RoleBinding history (csv) 3) kms_events_{keyid}.csv 4) cloudtrail_export.jsonl.gz 5) evidence_manifest.csv + README.md 6) signed_attestation.txt (PGP)

infra-bot: provisioning ephemeral audit-role (redwood-audit-exporter) with 48h TTL. will log creation and rotate creds before delivery.

zoe: people-ops: need approval to include service-account names. if no, we'll provide pseudonym mapping encrypted separately.

people-ops: approve pseudonymization. mapping file to be encrypted and transferred via SFTP upon NDA.

kai: commands i'll run:
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventSource,AttributeValue=iam.amazonaws.com --start-time 2025-04-01 --end-time 2026-04-01 > /tmp/iam-changes.json
jq '.Events[] | select(.EventName=="CreateRole" or .EventName=="UpdateRole" or .EventName=="AttachRolePolicy")' /tmp/iam-changes.json > /tmp/iam-role-changes.json

ana: for KMS events Splunk query to include in README:
index=cloudtrail eventSource=kms.amazonaws.com (eventName=GenerateDataKey OR eventName=Decrypt OR eventName=ReEncrypt OR eventName=CreateGrant) requestParameters.keyId="arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01-2345-6789-abcd" | table _time, eventName, userIdentity.principalId, sourceIPAddress

zoe: include incident tie-in: IR-2025-07 (staging key misconfig). ana, please pull redacted artifacts: timeline, alert screenshots, cloudtrail snippets, remediation commit.

ana: will produce redacted incident bundle and an appendix explaining noise from managed services (EBS, RDS).

infra-bot: CloudTrail retention check: 12 months of KMS events available in standard storage. starting export now.

kai: output packaging: s3://redwood-compliance/audits/2026-04/kms-evidence_bundle_v1.zip (SSE-KMS) with manifest.csv listing filename, sha256, description. Presigned URL for 7 days unless auditor requests SFTP.

people-ops: please redact personal identifiers; use pseudonyms where possible. signed attestation must include key fingerprint.

auditor_bot: PGP-signed attestation accepted. Include key fingerprint and generation timestamp.

zoe: timeline: IAM & CloudTrail extracts by Tue EOD, k8s audit slices Wed, assemble Thurs, upload Fri AM. I'll post link here once live.

kai: small caveat: some Decrypt events will show AWS service principals; we'll annotate those in README so they're not mistaken for human actors.

ana: adding a short replay script and commands to reproduce export and hashes.

infra-bot: created ephemeral role and recorded creation event at 2026-04-10T12:00:00Z.

zoe: checklist below and I'll tick off when done:
- iam-role-changes.csv (kai)
- k8s-rolebinding-history.csv (zoe)
- kms_events_key-abcd.csv (ana)
- cloudtrail_export.jsonl.gz (infra-bot)
- incident_bundle_redacted.zip (ana)
- manifest.csv + README.md (zoe)
- signed_attestation.pgp.txt (zoe)
- pseudonym_mapping_encrypted.tar.gpg (people-ops)

zoe: thanks everyone. delivering per auditor preference. will update with presigned link.
